caption: The drawing shows a wooden chair with a lyre-shaped backrest, rendered in shades of reddish-brown with visible darker wood grain patterns. The chair has four curved legs and a wide, cushioned seat, which is beige with subtle decorative patterns in light brown. The backrest features a lyre design with four vertical string-like elements between the arms of the lyre, and the top rail of the chair is twisted. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, separate illustration of the lyre motif, depicted in the same reddish-brown tones with three vertical strings and a curved frame. The background is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the chair and lyre.
title: Chair
